title: Python_ML
summary: A personal collection of Jupyter notebooks exploring various machine learning techniques including tab transformers, SMOTE, and intrusion-detection modeling on datasets like MonkeyPox and KDD99. Several notebooks import the standalone ctgan package directly and fit a CTGANSynthesizer to generate synthetic samples for class-imbalance handling and data augmentation.
